程序包 org.springframework.batch.core

类 PooledEmbeddedDataSource

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.batch.core.PooledEmbeddedDataSource
所有已实现的接口:
Wrapper, CommonDataSource, DataSource, org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.embedded.EmbeddedDatabase
public class PooledEmbeddedDataSource extends Object implements org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.embedded.EmbeddedDatabase
As of Spring 3.2, when a context is closed, the shutdown method is called on any beans that are registered. With an embedded database that uses a connection pool, this can leave the connection pool open with stale connections. This wraps an EmbeddedDatabase and ignores calls to EmbeddedDatabase.shutdown().
从以下版本开始:
3.0
